events.title: GriefShare - Grief Support Group
events.description:
The loss of a loved one turns your world upside down.
GriefShare support groups help you find the path toward stability, healing, and hope.

Please join us: Weekly starting at 5:00 PM, Tuesday, December 8th.
Register here: https://find.griefshare.org/groups/307059
Feel free to contact Pastor Jeremiah at jeremiahw@cowboychurch.org, or visit griefshare.org, if you have questions or would like more information.

events.recurring_details: Every Third Sunday of the Month
events.title: Jam Session
events.description:
All are welcome! Musicians and spectators! 
Join us for church service at 10 a.m.
Stay for lunch in the Hungry Cowboy Cafe.
Then let's Jam from 12:30 - 2:30 p.m. in the Multi-Purpose room off the gym.
Stay and linger with the music, it's good for the soul!

events.title: Sunday Message: Built for the Storm
events.description:
What do you do when life’s storms hit without warning?
BUILT FOR THE STORM
Faith That Holds When Life Gets Hard
GENESIS 6
Health concerns. Family struggles. An uncertain future. We can’t always control the storm—but we can learn to trust God through it. Join us this Sunday for an encouraging, practical look at Noah’s story, and hope for whatever you’re facing.
COWBOY CHURCH
Sunday, October 18 | 10:00 AM
Hwy 65 & Crosstown Blvd | Ham Lake, MN
Come as you are. You belong here!

Join us for a Christ-centered recovery journey using the Life Recovery Bible and Life Recovery Workbook as tools for restoration.  Along with biblical principles to liveyour life stronger in Christ.
